## Checklist

- [ ] The diff is small and focused.
- [ ] The change stays within the repository's current scope.
- [ ] Applicable authority and stable acceptance criteria were reviewed.
- [ ] Spec or acceptance criteria were updated and re-reviewed if behavior changed.
- [ ] Validation evidence supports every claimed PASS; checks not run are identified.
- [ ] No unintended ProjectSettings or Packages changes were introduced.
- [ ] Unity `.meta` files, GUIDs, legal/publication files, and intentional placeholders were preserved.
- [ ] No unrelated refactors or formatting-only edits were added.
- [ ] Any framework, architecture, global-constraint, dependency, package, settings, assembly-topology, or compatibility change has separate explicit approval.
- [ ] Consequential Git/GitHub or publication actions remain under Human Authority.
